Rules.InvariantScript:
"Reported " &
If(
    vAcceptedReportedSeconds < 60,
    vAcceptedReportedSeconds & " seconds ago",
    If(
        RoundDown(vAcceptedReportedSeconds / 60, 0) = 1,
        "1 minute ago",
        RoundDown(vAcceptedReportedSeconds / 60, 0) & " minutes ago"
    )
)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString: "You are " & Text(vAcceptedDistance, "0.0") & " km away, " & "Estimated arrival: " & vEstimatedTime & " minutes"

Rules.InvariantScript:
If(
    vActionStatus = "On the way",
    RGBA(97, 2, 2, 1),
    RGBA(0, 4, 255, 25)
)
